cc:Work.dc:title: Corrected before and after diagram of the chart widget refactor

svg.title: Corrected before and after diagram of the chart widget refactor
svg.desc: Left side shows class inheritance: a leaf chart class extends a mid-level chart-type class extends a base chart class, with the base class holding all props and cross-filter logic, and methods overridden at each level. Right side shows the corrected functional composition: the top-level variant component configures a mid-level component via props with no hook or state of its own, the mid-level component owns the shared data hook and rendering logic, and the bottom presentational component receives the hook result as a plain prop rather than calling the hook itself.
